text_block_list.name: Rei
text_block_list.text:
We were able to purify the kagami mochi in the end.
All thanks to you, of course.
text_block_list.orig_text:
無事に鏡餅を浄化できたね。
これもキミのおかげだ。

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text:
Thanks so much, Mr. Knight!
But guess what? We've got a super duper special present for you!
Here you go!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ありがとね、
騎士くん！
　
そこで〜……
ななななんと！
あたしたちからのお礼ですっ！
　
はい、
どうぞっ！

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text:
It's New Year's pocket money, specially for you.
The three of us decided that we'd split our own to share with you.
Hopefully it's enough to make you happy.
text_block_list.orig_text:
これ……
騎士クンへのお年玉。
わたしたちのお年玉を、
騎士クンにもおすそ分けしようって
みんなで決めたの。
喜んでもらえると、
うれしいな……
